output.headline: Intermountain Health is a strategic with a deal in the target's own sub-sector, but one deal and no Midwest presence make this a low-conviction call.
output.differentiator: Its single precedent, $789M, is larger than any peer's median deal, so a $200M target is no stretch in size. Same-sub-sector share is its strongest factor. [T:record, S:sector_share]
output.why_them: Healthcare Services strategic with a platform precedent; Midwest entry

acquirer_overview.title: A single-deal strategic from Salt Lake City with Healthcare Services roots
points: Strategic buyer whose home sub-sector is Healthcare Services; 33 hospitals in Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana, headquartered in Salt Lake City. [B:buyer, P:2]
Completed a merger with SCL Health in 2022, extending into Colorado, Kansas and Montana; it left Kansas in 2024. [P:1, P:2]
Record is one control deal, in 2022, and it closed: 1 of 1 (100%). [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Same-sub-sector share is the case; a thin record limits it
points: Share of its deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood. [S:sector_share]
Platform Build and Scale each apply to 1 of 1 deals, against 23% of all deals in the file. That is a distinct motive, though it rests on one deal. [M:platform_build, M:scale]
Target margin close to what it usually buys is a modest factor; a deal no bigger than any it has done is a slight factor. [S:margin_fit, S:not_bigger]

precedent_activity.title: One closed 2022 platform deal in the target's own sub-sector
points: Paramount Care Partners: $789M Platform Investment, 2022, at 12.5x EBITDA and 3.03x revenue, closed. [D:MA-2022-0183]
That deal was Multi-Regional; it has no deals in the target's region and 0 of 1 in the $100M-$400M size band. [K:by_region, K:size_band]
No deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors and none outside provider services. [T:record]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; its own history sits lower
points: 70 comparable deals in the $100M-$400M band: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th. [V:comps]
Target margin of 16.8% sits above the comps' median of 12.9%, supporting the 75th percentile. Its own median paid is 12.5x. [V:comps]
Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M (cost synergies, half realised). Buyer revenue is not researched, so balance-sheet capacity is unconfirmed. [V:synergy]

risk_flags.title: Thin track record
risk_flags.concern: Only one deal in the file, in 2022, and recent activity is a slight factor against. [T:record, S:recency]
risk_flags.mitigant: That deal was in the target's own sub-sector and closed.
risk_flags.reality: No adjacent provider deals; this is why conviction is Low. [C:conviction, T:record]

risk_flags.title: No Midwest footprint
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region; its hospitals are in Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana. [T:record, P:2]
risk_flags.mitigant: The 2022 SCL Health merger and Geographic Expansion motive show it has entered new states before. [P:1, M:geographic_expansion]
risk_flags.reality: It left Kansas in 2024, so Midwest commitment is unproven. [P:2]

risk_flags.title: Price and competitive process
risk_flags.concern: Its 12.5x median paid is below the 15.3x needed for upper-quartile pricing. [V:comps]
risk_flags.mitigant: Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M could support a higher bid. [V:synergy]
risk_flags.reality: It is 10th of 10 on the priority list at a 3.6% likelihood. [R:rank]

conviction.rationale: Low because it has only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector, 0 in adjacent provider sub-sectors and none in the target's region. [C:conviction, T:record]
